pipeline_steps.name: Frame
pipeline_steps.description: Resolve goal to ontology anchors; record known-connections baseline.

pipeline_steps.name: Fragment mining (cross-corpus)
pipeline_steps.description: Extract typed fragments from literature / structured DBs / raw sources via the source adapters.

pipeline_steps.name: Bridge discovery
pipeline_steps.description: Find A-C pairs with no direct edge but >=k independent B-paths across >=2 corpora (Swanson ABC).

pipeline_steps.name: Falsification gauntlet
pipeline_steps.description: Independent veto gates G1-G4 (novelty, groundedness, contradiction, plausibility); every kill logged.

pipeline_steps.name: Tournament + evolution
pipeline_steps.description: Elo pairwise-debate ranking and refinement of survivors.

pipeline_steps.name: Emit run bundle
pipeline_steps.description: Write hypotheses, kill-log, fragments, provenance, and this BCO.

execution_domain.script_driver: claude-code (agentic; model-driven procedure, not a deterministic script)

algorithmic_error.generation_nondeterminism: The forge run is agentic; re-running may surface different hypotheses. This BCO makes the run auditable and re-attemptable, not byte-reproducible. Deterministic scoring of a captured bundle lives in eval/score.py.
algorithmic_error.novelty_scope: Novelty is judged against the sources searched at the cutoff; a connection absent from those sources but present elsewhere may be mislabeled novel.
algorithmic_error.surfacing_bias: The gauntlet optimizes precision; true hypotheses can be killed (false negatives) by design.
